name: Azuga Fleet
description: Azuga Fleet is GPS fleet tracking and telematics software with vehicle tracking, driver scoring and rewards, alerts, geofencing, vehicle diagnostics, scheduled maintenance, safety tools, reporting, and higher-tier efficiency and integration features.
best_for: Small and midsize fleets that want GPS tracking, driver safety scoring, maintenance visibility, and unusually transparent per-vehicle subscription pricing.
features: GPS vehicle tracking with two-minute location updates on the published base plan
Alerts and notifications for events such as speeding and hard braking
Driver scores and rewards plus geofencing and trip visibility
Safety features and distracted-driving controls on higher plans
Fuel-card integration, API integration, route optimization, and enhanced efficiency features on higher plans

tiers.name: BasicFleet
tiers.notes: Core tracking, alerts, driver scores/rewards, reports, maintenance, and geofencing.

tiers.name: SafeFleet
tiers.notes: Adds additional safety and efficiency features.

tiers.name: CompleteFleet
tiers.notes: Adds the broader tailored fleet feature package.

tiers.name: AI SafetyCam
tiers.notes: Optional dual-facing AI SafetyCam starts at $49.99/month.

pros: Publishes exact per-vehicle prices for three core fleet plans
Driver scoring and rewards are part of the core fleet positioning
Combines tracking with diagnostics and maintenance rather than only location data
cons: Location update frequency on the published base plan is less frequent than some premium real-time platforms
Several safety, fuel, API, and optimization capabilities sit on higher plans

alternatives.name: Geotab
alternatives.description: Fleet telematics platform with GO hardware, MyGeotab dashboards, compliance, maintenance, and a large marketplace.
alternatives.best_for: Fleets that prefer a broader ecosystem and sales-configured telematics package.

alternatives.name: Verizon Connect
alternatives.description: Reveal-based GPS fleet tracking with near-real-time maps, vehicle history, and reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Fleets wanting an established enterprise tracking vendor.

alternatives.name: Samsara
alternatives.description: Connected operations platform spanning fleet telematics, safety cameras, equipment, and workforce tools.
alternatives.best_for: Fleets needing a broader connected-operations stack.
